```{r}

titanic_wide <- data.frame(Titanic)
head(titanic_wide)
#>   Class    Sex   Age Survived Freq
#> 1   1st   Male Child       No    0
#> 2   2nd   Male Child       No    0
#> 3   3rd   Male Child       No   35
#> 4  Crew   Male Child       No    0
#> 5   1st Female Child       No    0
#> 6   2nd Female Child       No    0
ggplot(data = titanic_wide,
       aes(axis1 = Class, axis2 = Sex, axis3 = Age,
           y = Freq)) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Class", "Sex", "Age"), expand = c(.2, .05)) +
  xlab("Demographic") +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = Survived)) +
  geom_stratum() +
  geom_text(stat = "stratum", aes(label = after_stat(stratum))) +
  theme_minimal() +
  ggtitle("passengers on the maiden voyage of the Titanic",
          "stratified by demographics and survival")
```

```{r}
large_deer_alluvial <- data.frame(
  Variable = c("MAX_DAMS_1000m", "woodland_shelter_value",
               "Woodland_edge_cover_1000m", "Arable_cover_1000m", "Perennial_cover_1000m",
               "Woodland_palatability"),
  Index = c("Thermoregulation_Index", "Thermoregulation_Index",
            "Attraction_Index", "Attraction_Index", "Attraction_Index",
            "Woodland_Value_Index"),
  Importance_Value = c(1, 0.2, 0.1, 1, 1, 1)
)

large_deer_impact_risk <- c(
  Woodland_Value_Index = 0.3,
  Attraction_Index = 1,
  Thermoregulation_Index = 0.2
)

# Add Impact risk weight to each record via matching Index
large_deer_alluvial <- large_deer_alluvial %>%
  mutate(Impact_Risk = "Impact Risk",
         Impact_Importance = large_deer_impact_risk[Index])

# Calculate final flow value for each alluvium
large_deer_alluvial <- large_deer_alluvial %>%
  mutate(Flow_Value = Importance_Value * Impact_Importance)

# Check data
large_deer_alluvial


# Build proportional weighted alluvial plot
large_deer_alluvial_template <- ggplot(large_deer_alluvial,
       aes(axis1 = Variable, axis2 = Index, axis3 = Impact_Risk,
           y = Flow_Value)) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = Index), width = 0.2, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_stratum(width = 0.3, fill = "white", color = "black") +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Variable", "Index", "Impact Risk"), expand = c(.05, .05)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    #legend.position = "none",
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  ) +
  ggtitle("Large Deer CPT Alluvial Plot (weighted)") +
  ylab("Importance Value") +
  xlab("")

ggsave("C:/Users/ik929086/Documents/iDeer/output/plots/large_deer_alluvial_template.pdf", plot = large_deer_alluvial_template, width = 6, height = 4)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggalluvial)
library(dplyr)

# Small deer variable to index mapping
small_deer_alluvial <- data.frame(
  Variable = c("Woodland_cover_400m", "LF_cover_400m",
               "Woodland_edge_cover", "Woodland_palatability"),
  Index = c("Connectivity_Index", "Connectivity_Index",
            "Attraction_Index", "Woodland_Value_Index"),
  Importance_Value = c(1, 0.6, 1, 1)
)

# Impact risk values for each index
small_deer_impact_risk <- c(Connectivity_Index = 0.2, 
                            Attraction_Index = 0.5, 
                            Woodland_Value_Index = 0.8)  # used consistent name

# Merge Impact Risk values into the data frame by matching on Index
small_deer_alluvial <- small_deer_alluvial %>%
  mutate(Impact_Risk = "Impact Risk",
         Impact_Importance = small_deer_impact_risk[Index])

# Final combined Importance Value (variable to index to impact risk flow)
small_deer_alluvial <- small_deer_alluvial %>%
  mutate(Flow_Value = Importance_Value * Impact_Importance)

# Inspect structure
small_deer_alluvial

# Build weighted alluvial plot
small_deer_alluvial_template <- ggplot(small_deer_alluvial,
       aes(axis1 = Variable, axis2 = Index, axis3 = Impact_Risk,
           y = Flow_Value)) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = Index), width = 0.2, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_stratum(width = 0.3, fill = "white", color = "black") +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Variable", "Index", "Impact Risk"), expand = c(.05, .05)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    #legend.position = "none",
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  ) +
  ggtitle("Small Deer CPT Alluvial Plot (weighted)") +
  ylab("Importance Value") +
  xlab("")

ggsave("C:/Users/ik929086/Documents/iDeer/output/plots/small_deer_alluvial_template.pdf", plot = small_deer_alluvial_template, width = 6, height = 4)
```

```{r}
#Save raster tiles to be used in the figure

#Read in rasters for variables
#large deer
max_dams <- raster("C:/Users/ik929086/Documents/iDeer/output/GB_datasets_2023/large_deer/polys_unmerged_max_summed_DAMS_raster_normalised.tif")
shelter_quality <- raster("C:/Users/ik929086/Documents/iDeer/output/GB_datasets_2023/large_deer/NFI_woodland_shelter_value_index_large_deer.tif")
arable_cover <- raster("C:/Users/ik929086/Documents/iDeer/output/GB_datasets_2023//large_deer/percentage_cover_arable_1000_2023.tif")
perennial_cover <- raster("C:/Users/ik929086/Documents/iDeer/output/GB_datasets_2023/large_deer/percentage_cover_perennial_1000m_2023.tif")
wood_value_large_deer <- raster("C:/Users/ik929086/Documents/iDeer/output/GB_datasets_2023/large_deer/NFI_woodland_food_value_index_large_deer_two_levels.tif")
wood_edges_1000m <- raster("C:/Users/ik929086/Documents/iDeer/output/GB_datasets_2023/large_deer/NFI_focal_woodland_edge_area_1000m_percentage_cover.tif")

#small deer
LF_cover <- raster("C:/Users/ik929086/Documents/iDeer/output/GB_datasets_2023/small_deer/NFI_mean_percentage_focal_area_lf_extracted_to_polys_400m.tif")
wood_value_small_deer <- raster("C:/Users/ik929086/Documents/iDeer/output/GB_datasets_2023/small_deer/NFI_woodland_food_value_index_small_deer_bng.tif")
wood_edges_400m <- raster("C:/Users/ik929086/Documents/iDeer/output/GB_datasets_2023/small_deer/NFI_focal_woodland_edge_area_400m_percentage_cover.tif")
wood_area_400m <- raster("C:/Users/ik929086/Documents/iDeer/output/GB_datasets_2023/small_deer/NFI_mean_percentage_focal_area_woods_extracted_to_polys_400m.tif")



#Make a 5x5km tile around point 50.477566, -4.847737 (Cornwall)
#crop all rasters to this tile
# Define the center point (longitude, latitude)
center_point <- SpatialPoints(matrix(c(-4.847737, 50.477566), ncol=2), 
                              proj4string=CRS("+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84"))

# Transform to same CRS as rasters (assuming all rasters have same CRS)
target_crs <- crs(max_dams)
center_point_proj <- spTransform(center_point, target_crs)

# Define a 5x5 km extent (2500 m in each direction from the center)
buffer_size <- 2500  # in meters
x_center <- coordinates(center_point_proj)[1]
y_center <- coordinates(center_point_proj)[2]

# Create extent object
tile_extent <- extent(x_center - buffer_size, x_center + buffer_size,
                      y_center - buffer_size, y_center + buffer_size)

# Crop all rasters to this extent
max_dams_crop <- crop(max_dams, tile_extent)
#make non-values in raster NAs
#non-values were assigned -0.02747456 in normalisation process
max_dams_crop[max_dams_crop <= -0.02747456] <- NA
shelter_quality_crop <- crop(shelter_quality, tile_extent)
arable_cover_crop <- crop(arable_cover, tile_extent)
perennial_cover_crop <- crop(perennial_cover, tile_extent)
wood_value_large_deer_crop <- crop(wood_value_large_deer, tile_extent)
wood_edges_1000m_crop <- crop(wood_edges_1000m, tile_extent)

LF_crop <- crop(LF_cover, tile_extent)
wood_edges_400m_crop <- crop(wood_edges_400m, tile_extent)
wood_value_small_deer_crop <- crop(wood_value_small_deer, tile_extent)
wood_area_crop <- crop(wood_area_400m, tile_extent)

# Optionally: stack them together for joint operations
large_deer_raster_stack <- stack(max_dams_crop, shelter_quality_crop, arable_cover_crop, 
                      perennial_cover_crop, wood_value_large_deer_crop, wood_edges_1000m_crop)

small_deer_raster_stack <- stack(LF_crop, wood_edges_400m_crop, wood_value_small_deer_crop, wood_area_crop)

# Plot to check
plot(large_deer_raster_stack)
plot(small_deer_raster_stack)

# Define custom colour palette
custom_palette <- colorRampPalette(c("#354A9A", "#6EA6CD", "#FEDA8B", "#F67E4B", "#A50026"))

# Define file paths for each raster plot
output_dir <- "C:/Users/ik929086/Documents/iDeer/output/plots/"

# List of rasters and corresponding filenames
raster_list <- list(
  max_dams_crop = max_dams_crop,
  shelter_quality_crop = shelter_quality_crop,
  arable_cover_crop = arable_cover_crop,
  perennial_cover_crop = perennial_cover_crop,
  wood_value_large_deer_crop = wood_value_large_deer_crop,
  wood_value_small_deer_crop = wood_value_small_deer_crop,
  wood_edges_400m_crop = wood_edges_400m_crop,
  wood_edges_1000m_crop = wood_edges_1000m_crop,
  wood_area_crop = wood_area_crop,
  LF_crop = LF_crop
)

# Function to save each raster in a stack as an individual PDF with custom colours
save_stack_as_individual_pdfs <- function(raster_stack, prefix) {
  for (i in 1:nlayers(raster_stack)) {
    layer_name <- names(raster_stack)[i]
    pdf_filename <- paste0(prefix, "_", layer_name, ".pdf")
    
    pdf(file.path(output_dir, pdf_filename))
    plot(raster_stack[[i]], 
         main=layer_name,
         col=custom_palette(100),
         legend=TRUE)
    dev.off()
  }
}

# Save large deer cropped stack — individual PDFs
save_stack_as_individual_pdfs(large_deer_raster_stack, "large_deer")

# Save small deer cropped stack — individual PDFs
save_stack_as_individual_pdfs(small_deer_raster_stack, "small_deer")
```

```{r}
replace_zeros_with_na <- function(r_stack) {
  for (i in 1:nlayers(r_stack)) {
    r <- r_stack[[i]]
    r[r == 0] <- NA
    r_stack[[i]] <- r
  }
  return(r_stack)
}

large_deer_indices_stack <- replace_zeros_with_na(large_deer_indices_stack)
small_deer_indices_stack <- replace_zeros_with_na(small_deer_indices_stack)

# --- Define your custom colour palette ---

custom_palette <- colorRampPalette(c("#354A9A", "#6EA6CD", "#FEDA8B", "#F67E4B", "#A50026"))

# --- Function to save individual raster layers as PDFs with custom colors ---

output_dir <- "C:/Users/ik929086/Documents/iDeer/output/plots/"
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir)

save_stack_as_individual_pdfs <- function(r_stack, prefix) {
  for (i in 1:nlayers(r_stack)) {
    layer_name <- names(r_stack)[i]
    pdf_filename <- paste0(prefix, "_", layer_name, ".pdf")
    
    pdf(file.path(output_dir, pdf_filename))
    plot(r_stack[[i]], 
         main = layer_name,
         col = custom_palette(100),
         legend = TRUE,
         theme_void())
    dev.off()
  }
}

# --- Save the cropped stacks as individual PDFs ---

save_stack_as_individual_pdfs(large_deer_indices_stack, "large_deer_index")
save_stack_as_individual_pdfs(small_deer_indices_stack, "small_deer_index")
```
